input.upstream_note: MLIP pathway estimates (not DFT); 1 ML H, 1x1 cell; ZPE is H-only, sensitivity only

upstream.note: MLIP-based harmonic-TST estimates (H-only Hessian, substrate frozen; 1 ML H, 1x1 cell, collective H motion); not DFT-validated. Classical Vineyard hTST is the main result.

provenance.note: MLIP-based harmonic-TST estimates; lattice model parameterised with 1 ML collective barriers (single walker, no H-H interactions); not DFT-validated. The +-0.05 eV band is a judgment-based range, not a statistical error bar. Valid only above ~150-200 K (tunnelling crossover 85-101 K).

classical_direct_upper.label: classical + direct B1<->B2 (grid saddle - 0.05 eV, Vineyard nu)

M1.protocol: frozen DFT substrate, H z relaxed, 0.28 A grid; straight-line maximum = upper estimate of the direct-route saddle (T1-01: freeing the substrate lowered the S1 grid estimate by ~0.03 eV)

M0.protocol: frozen DFT substrate, H z relaxed, 0.28 A grid; straight-line maximum = upper estimate of the direct-route saddle (T1-01: freeing the substrate lowered the S1 grid estimate by ~0.03 eV)
